answer: Agents register through a diversity-sampled quorum of independent attestation harnesses, each running different code and operators. A new identity must pass a randomly drawn harness subset, and the reputation delta between harnesses must fall within a small tolerance band; a sybil cluster sharing one operator fails because colluding harnesses cluster and get down-weighted. Registering each fake identity also costs a bonded deposit locked in a harbor contract that is slashed if correlation analysis flags shared infrastructure, much like water sinking into karst rather than pooling on the.
